$comment: This repository has no published URL yet, so a config's $schema is the repository-relative path schemas/v2/config/output.json; the loader checks that suffix and never dereferences it. Give this file an absolute $id when the repository has a public home.
title: Where results go

comorbidities.description: How many simultaneous diseases the comorbidity table reports.

folder.description: The output directory. ${VAR} is expanded; an undefined variable is an error. May be empty when --output is given instead, but not both.

file_name.description: Used EXACTLY as configured. {TIMESTAMP} and {JOBID} are optional tokens. Upstream ignores this name unless it contains a token (audit B-08) and forces a timestamp, which stops two runs of the same config ever writing comparable paths (N-15); the timestamp lives in the JSON metadata instead.
